bio: Housed within SO/ Berlin Das Stue hotel, on the edge of the Großer Tiergarten and right next to the Spanish Embassy, The Casual is not to be missed. The modern, elegant and cosy design creates a relaxed atmosphere that puts diners in mind of an upscale living room. The French-influenced cuisine includes classics such as fillet of beef tartare, grilled sirloin steak or moules marinières. You can also sip on an aperitif or digestif in the Stue Bar directly adjacent to the restaurant. In fine weather, make a beeline for the quiet, leafy terrace in the inner courtyard – exclusive access for hotel patrons to the Zoo Berlin is a real highlight of staying here!...
